name: databasemcp
description: Database workbench MCP - connects to Oracle, Postgres and libSQL databases with query execution, schema introspection, explain plans, and AI-powered SQL optimization

streamable-http.description: Database workbench MCP - connects to Oracle, Postgres and libSQL databases with query execution, schema introspection, explain plans, and AI-powered SQL optimization

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List connection presets defined in .env (dialect, description, autoconnect — passwords never shown)

tools.name: connect_preset
tools.description: Connect using a preset by number or NAME alias; first connection becomes active

tools.name: connect_database
tools.description: Connect to a database (oracle|postgres|libsql) and register it under a name; first connection becomes active

tools.name: disconnect_database
tools.description: Disconnect and remove a named database connection

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all registered database connections (never shows credentials)

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query (SELECT/WITH) and return up to max_rows rows

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute an SQL statement (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL), commit, report affected rows

tools.name: get_schemas
tools.description: Get columns, constraints and foreign keys for a table (cached per connection)

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables with their comments on a connection

tools.name: explain_plan
tools.description: Return the execution plan for a SQL statement (dialect-specific)

tools.name: get_valid_languages
tools.description: Oracle-only: get valid language codes from the LANGUES table

tools.name: get_sql_optimization_rules
tools.description: Show the user-local SQL optimization rules (optimization.json)

tools.name: get_proc_rules
tools.description: Show the user-local Pro*C coding rules (proc_rules.md)

tools.name: optimize_sql_with_ai
tools.description: Suggest SQL optimizations via AI using the user-local rules and live schema context

USERID.description: Oracle connection for the lazy 'default' connection (format: username/password)

DB_HOST.description: Oracle host for the lazy 'default' connection

DB_PORT.description: Oracle port for the lazy 'default' connection

DB_SERVICE_NAME.description: Oracle service name for the lazy 'default' connection

DB_AUTOCONNECT.description: Set to 0 to disable the lazy env-default connection entirely

ORACLE_QUERY_TIMEOUT.description: Oracle call timeout in seconds (applied per acquire; pool wait = 3x)

DB_LOCK_WAIT_S.description: How long a tool waits for a busy connection's lock before reporting it busy

AI_API_KEY.description: API key for the AI SQL optimization

AI_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway base URL for the AI SQL optimization

AI_MODEL.description: Model name for the AI SQL optimization
